summary: Mr. Harari discusses the community customs for maqam selection and haftara readings for Parashat Aharei Mot, Parashat Kedoshim, and Parashat Emor. He explains which maqamot are sung when Aharei Mot and Kedoshim are read separately or combined, citing specific haftara passages from Yehezkel. He also reviews the maqam Sega custom for Parashat Emor along with shishi verse options for these portions.
